object.attr: stakeholder: a user or agent has to find the object to fix it. These are the codes about one object; the SCHEMA_, DOC_ and RULEFILE_ codes concern the manifest or the rules file (review Q25). The documents don't say whether messages name the object.
object.description: Mellon shall report each ATTR_, OUTLINE_, OBJECT_NOT_IN_OUTLINE, LINK_, FIGURE_ and RULE_ validation error with the object ID of the object, outline entry or link source concerned.
